title: GOLD_HUNTER FAST V2 — Phase 0 (Data Integrity + Strategy Research)

constraints.pr119: FROZEN V1 archive — do not modify/merge

1_resyncRootCause.note: V1 labeled every reset transport_reconnect; invalid-book and stale shared scheduleReconnect. Stream evidence shows periodic feed gaps, not crossed-book storms.
1_resyncRootCause.rootCause: Observed market-data input silence of ~27s median immediately before stale watchdog reconnects (seq advances by 1 across the wall-clock gap).

feedGapDiagnosis.defensibleFinding: Observed market-data input silence of ~27s median immediately before stale watchdog reconnects (seq advances by 1 across the wall-clock gap).
feedGapDiagnosis.notClaimed: Do NOT claim Spotware itself caused the gaps without direct transport evidence.
feedGapDiagnosis.whyUnresolved: Persisted V1 chunks contain only post-bridge collector records (event receiveSeq, decision, status). They do not include raw transport/callback timestamps, WS disconnect frames, subscription flag changes, bridge queue wait during the silent interval, or event-loop stall probes. Therefore upstream cTrader silence vs transport disconnect vs subscription loss vs process stall cannot be proven from this dataset.
telemetryRequiredNextRun: classified resync reason counters (already patched in Phase 0 code)

design: resetMarketDataForResync allocates a receiveSeq and returns closedTrades + resyncMarker + decisions.
LiveBridge persists exactly one EXIT collector row per force-closed trade (tradeExit audit) then one RESYNC marker event.
Replay applyStreamEvent applies RESYNC at the same sequence; skips RESYNC_EXIT companions to avoid double-close.
Runtime classifies triggers: stale_spot/depth/ages_null vs invalid_crossed_book/no_bids/no_asks vs transport/timeout.

3_missingExitFix.problem: V1 resetMarketDataForResync closed via adapter+engine.closed without finishDecision/collector EXIT (~34 missing).
3_missingExitFix.fix: Engine emits EXIT decision + persistedExitEvidence; bridge records tradeExit; closed count must equal persisted EXIT count.

5_rawSpecialistAnalysis.v1Limitation: setupDetections counted only best-of selected setup; raw A/B/C eligibility was not persisted.
5_rawSpecialistAnalysis.interpretation: C=0 selected does NOT prove C never met raw conditions. Stream shows pullback_not_confirmed=109 (impulse present but pullback/reaccel gates failed) and near_A only 4 times; no near_C rows because soft quality path rarely produced a C hit even with minSetupQuality lowered in diagnostics. Likely: C impulse+efficiency+pullback+reaccel conjunction is rare in this London sample; when present, A/B may still win best-of. Phase 0B instrumentation now records raw eligible/quality/failedConditions for A,B,C on every candidate evaluation.

9_earlyFailureCounterfactual.correction: Withdrawn impossible engine-MFE<0 rules. Replaced with A–D live-implementable variants.

definitions.engineMFE: Live engine: openTrade.mfe initializes at 0; updateOpenTrade does mfe = Math.max(mfe, unrealizedSignedExecutable). Therefore engine MFE is always >= 0. MFE < 0 and MFE < -0.05 are impossible in the real engine.
definitions.engineMAE: Live engine: mae initializes at 0; mae = Math.min(mae, unrealizedSignedExecutable). MAE tracks the most adverse signed executable move (typically <= 0).
definitions.signedExecutableMove: At time t for an open trade: BUY => bid_t - entryPrice; SELL => entryPrice - ask_t. This is current mark-to-market vs entry (can be negative immediately due to spread).
definitions.priorOfflineBug: The withdrawn rule `mfe<-0.05 AND alignedVel<=0 by 3000ms` did NOT use engine MFE. Offline path used max(signedExecutableMove over horizon) but incorrectly treated that series as if negative values were valid "MFE". In practice the offline variable was max_t signedExecutableMove(t) over [0, horizon], which is often still negative in the first seconds because of spread — i.e. peak signed P/L so far, NOT engine MFE (which would clamp that peak via Math.max with 0). Renaming alone is insufficient; CFs below use explicitly named live-implementable quantities.

9_earlyFailureCounterfactual.interpretation: Even after correcting MFE semantics, 3s abort variants remain unprofitable (PF<<1). They reduce some losses but do not produce a positive-edge V2 rule. RESEARCH_ONLY; do not ship.

conclusion.explicit: Phase 0 has NOT demonstrated a profitable V2 rule set. Individual counterfactuals remain negative expectancy / PF<1 (spread<=0.10 PF~0.62; corrected 3s aborts still PF<<1; re-entry cooldown PF still far below 1). Need genuine entry-edge improvement, not merely reduced losses. Do not combine many same-sample rules and call that validation. Any combination tests are IN-SAMPLE RESEARCH only; reserve independent periods for OOS.

experiments: Confirm whether E1 early-confirm reduces HARD_PROTECTION without killing HARVEST winners.
Only then consider trail/activation tweaks; TRAIL_HIT was mixed, HARVEST_FADE positive.
DATA_STALE exits should become rare once resync integrity + feed stall root cause addressed.
